title: Gap row BP-bac81f87 names a _gaps.md entry that is no longer open and its pack is good, and pool check never judges a gap row's route
goal: Every gap row of bench_pool.csv names an open _gaps.md entry (kbfacts.OPEN_GAP) and its pack routes to web; pool check names a gap row whose entry has closed or narrowed or whose pack does not route to web, so the landing that closes an entry fails a check while a row still names it

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool as b;bad=[r['id'] for r in b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE) if r['kind']=='gap' and b.scenario_pack(r['question'])[0]!='web'];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool as b;rows=b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE);g=next(r for r in rows if r['kind']=='gap' and r['source']!='_gaps.md#8f38c7a9');closed={**g,'id':'BP-closed','source':'_gaps.md#8f38c7a9'};good=next(r for r in rows if r['kind']=='sc_present');routed={**g,'id':'BP-routed','question':good['question']};out=b.check_problems(rows+[closed,routed]);named=[i for i in ('BP-closed','BP-routed') if any(l.startswith(i+':') for l in out)];print(named);sys.exit(0 if len(named)==2 else 1)

clauses.clause: Every gap row of bench_pool.csv names an open _gaps.md entry (kbfacts.OPEN_GAP) and its pack routes to web
pool check names a gap row whose entry has closed or narrowed or whose pack does not route to web, so the landing that closes an entry fails a check while a row still names it

gates.question: How does pool check judge a gap row, and does pool build route-filter the gap draw? Recommended: check only; a build that packs every candidate adds cost and moves the draw for every seed, and a redraw landing on a non-web entry is named by the same check.

notes: Merged from BG-sclw54q6 at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (same row BP-bac81f87, same fix): a stored gap row naming a closed entry fails a check at the landing that closes it, not at a later review. Premise: the repro prints ['BP-bac81f87'] and exits 1 on 2026-10-13; a pool build into a scratch copy of the committed file (no paid call, all checks cached) replaces four of the five gap rows (gap_section is re-drawn from the seed, so BP-f3952b33, BP-c6881637 and BP-91d04d4d may be no longer open either). Plan: edit the gap rows, not a whole-pool rebuild: the same build also redraws 24 offkb, cites, decision and snippet rows, so take only the gap rows from a scratch build. pool check judges a gap row by its source hash in _gaps.md (a missing entry counts as closed) and by bench_pool.scenario_pack's route. A new test goes in test_bench.py's pool check test. Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 5 of 15, "Benchmark pool rows: answer regexes, stale rows, the gap row, a pool build that asks before paying and a corrected report"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed.
